name: kenan
description: Kenan Android shell for the shared Pi Remote client

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.android:test: node --test release-info.test.mjs && bun test connect-adb.test.ts && npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug --no-daemon
